title: Photoactivatable and photolabile pharmacophores: lessons learned from capsaicin
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CB00124B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Nils Imse, Lucia Rojas, Cristina Gil Herrero, Sebastian Thallmair, JeongSeop Rhee, Nadja A. Simeth
Structurally merging light-susceptible with bioactive molecules allows to generate photolabile chromopharmacophores. Using capsaicinoids, chromopharmacophores could activate the TRPV1 channel, while no activation is observed for the photoproducts.
